subject: Re: Role: React Native Technical Lead- Retail Domain / Android developer with react native exp?
body:
Hi Ankit,

I saw your React Native Technical Lead (Retail, Atlanta onsite) requirement and would like to be considered. My tailored resume is attached.

- 6+ years of hands-on React Native on iOS and Android, 10+ years in software overall, leading mobile teams at Walmart Global Tech (500K+ daily users) and HCSC (1M+ members).
- Owns architecture, coding standards, and production support: crash and log analysis with Dynatrace, root-cause fixes that reached 99.9% crash-free sessions, release engineering through App Store Connect and Google Play with feature flags and phased rollouts.
- Native modules and bridging (Swift/Kotlin), secure auth and token handling, push, deep links, payments and analytics SDKs; Jest, Detox, Appium; CI/CD pipelines.
- Mentors onshore and offshore engineers and coordinates with product, backend, QA, DevOps, and security through releases and hypercare.
- Open to 100% onsite in Atlanta.

I'm on a TN visa and available on C2C; glad to discuss the rate. Happy to talk this week at (773) 708-2882.
